dedupe_keys.name: potpourri a python package for multi period optimal power flow in active distribution grids

description: Steffen Kortmann and colleagues at RWTH Aachen's IAEW publish potpourri, a Python library for AC and DC optimal power flow with multiple operating periods. It builds Pyomo optimisation models from pandapower networks and includes batteries, EVs, heat pumps, photovoltaics and wind generation. The September 2026 version 0.7.0 is free under MIT, as stated by Zenodo and the repository README. Coverage is user-defined distribution networks and time horizons. Current documentation supports Python 3.10–3.12 and shows ninety-six fifteen-minute periods as an example. Solvers are installed separately, and optional commercial solvers have separate licence requirements. The model supports flexibility dispatch and hosting-capacity simulations; solver convergence and benchmark agreement were not checked here. Related catalogue entries include pandapower, SimBench and PGLib-OPF. GitHub's automatic licence detector returned NOASSERTION, but the explicit README and Zenodo licence fields both identify MIT.
